findings.issue: Bootstrap admitted manager bytes before copying them into staging.
findings.disposition: Fixed: compare staged manager bytes with the supplied SHA-256 before execution.

findings.issue: Engine admission accepted a forwarding manager and enabled recursive selection.
findings.disposition: Fixed: require an engine role probe and reject the reserved engine protocol on managers.

findings.issue: Wrapped admission failures suppressed actionable command diagnostics.
findings.disposition: Fixed: distinguish forwarded command exits from validation failures.

findings.issue: Recovery could mutate a journal resource without acquiring its home lease.
findings.disposition: Fixed: discover all pending resources and revalidate the closure under leases.

findings.issue: Explicit capture repositories could execute through another project’s engine.
findings.disposition: Fixed: validate explicit repository authority before forwarding capture.

findings.issue: Windows consumers passed a native manager executable to PowerShell -File.
findings.disposition: Fixed: invoke the native executable directly; runtime certification remains excluded.

findings.issue: Self-update ignored the invoked custom manager installation path.
findings.disposition: Fixed: use the physical executing manager path when no destination is supplied.

findings.issue: Read-only inspection rejected retained state from a deleted worktree.
findings.disposition: Fixed: allow explicit registry inspection without live repository validation.

findings.issue: Existing version aliases failed outside a configured project.
findings.disposition: Fixed: route version aliases through the explicitly provisioned companion engine.

findings.issue: Manager installation overwrote an unowned checksum sidecar.
findings.disposition: Fixed: reject orphan or edited checksum metadata before replacement.

findings.issue: Foreign local binaries bypassed executable role and version validation.
findings.disposition: Fixed: refuse foreign local artifacts; published foreign caches disclose deferred runtime validation.

findings.issue: Active contributor guidance described the retired single-binary wrapper layout.
findings.disposition: Fixed: document separate native artifacts. Related server-forwarding claim refuted by successful direct help execution.

findings.issue: Tests omitted ordinary cached-engine identity rejection.
findings.disposition: Fixed: add a production-path negative oracle with a positive control.

findings.issue: A reviewer alleged recovery must leave every file unchanged on conflict.
findings.disposition: Refuted: edited bytes and the pending journal survive and recovery resumes; whole-state rollback was not promised.

findings.issue: Lexical normalization changed explicit cache roots containing symlink/.. .
findings.disposition: Fixed: resolve physical path semantics and verify with a real native command.

findings.issue: The operator reference described wrapper replacement and whole-bootstrap rollback.
findings.disposition: Fixed: document native protocols, per-operation recovery and foreign-cache limits.

findings.issue: The active operator reference still named ledger schema v5.
findings.disposition: Fixed: align current operator guidance with schema v6.

findings.issue: The isolated build fixture omitted the new manager command.
findings.disposition: Fixed: build and distinguish both real native commands while retaining failure guards.

findings.issue: Updating an existing Windows manager requires manual replacement.
findings.disposition: Accepted debt: safe refusal preserves files; user owns deferred Windows support removal. No Windows runtime certification.

findings.issue: Another Codex home could commit before an interrupted legacy migration lost rollback authority.
findings.disposition: Fixed: shared typed discovery reference, private undo journal, complete lease closure and private-journal commit point.

findings.issue: The adoption reader rejected the receipt protocol emitted by the installer.
findings.disposition: Fixed: share protocol2 between receipt writer and reader; test their real round trip.

findings.issue: The active-worker installer fixture supplied only the engine artifact.
findings.disposition: Fixed: provide real verified manager and engine artifacts while retaining worker ACK and inode assertions.

findings.issue: Public installation recreated a deleted private transaction owner before recovery discovery.
findings.disposition: Fixed during correction verification: discover pending authority before creating the home; public regression preserves the reference and absent owner.

findings.issue: Live disable racing a worker fence was misclassified as supersession and failed shutdown.
findings.disposition: Fixed: recheck capture enablement before retirement and successor handling; retain pending generations and strict worker exit assertions.
